capabilities: Look up Bible verses and references on wol.jw.org via a Cloudflare worker
Wrap references in !! markers to make them clickable inline links
Render verse text inline as a callout block using a > suffix
List and load all references of the active note in a sidebar panel
Cache fetched results in memory for 30 minutes
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; lookups go through a Cloudflare worker that fetches and parses wol.jw.org HTML.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up Bible references from wol.jw.org or insert their text into notes.
summary: WOL Reference Tools lets you look up Bible verses from wol.jw.org by wrapping references in !!markers!! and inserting the text inline, in a modal or popover, or in a sidebar panel.
